text_block_list.text:
One day before training, I called out to her
to confront the issues she had been facing.
choice_data_list: Let's talk after training is over.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, understood.
And after wrapping up training.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I hear ya.
I'm gonna go get changed, so wait for me~."

However—no matter how long I waited,
she never came back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —I see, skipped out on you again, huh? Too bad, Sky hasn't come back to the dorm yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Man, standin' me up takes some serious guts!
Maybe I should hunt 'em down and beat some sense into 'em!?"
Just as I was somehow managing to calm down the fired-up Hishi Amazon...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
Sky's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand the situation.
I'll help you search.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There's actually something
I've been wanting to say to her too...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, even if we say we're searching, I already have a good idea of where it is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Trainer, you feel the same, don't you?

If she hasn't returned to the dorms...
There's only one place she could have gone. And that is—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
Tch, I'm not getting any bites at all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aaah, how boring...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Wait, why is King here too?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I have something to talk to you about, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be blunt.
You've been weird lately. Something is wrong with you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She'd always been irresponsible,
but she still kept her fighting spirit buried inside.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And yet lately, you're just grinning like a fool.
Like a deflated balloon!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha,
that's a pretty harsh thing to say~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's it, exactly that!
I can't stand that frivolous smirk of yours...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Something happened, didn't it?
Just tell me!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let me say this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —I'm just tired of racing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So my drive and fighting spirit completely vanished.
Ta-da! Are you satisfied with that explanation?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...After coming all this way.
Stop with the terrible jokes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Do you really think I'd say something like this as a joke?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's a lie. Saying you're bored is a lie.
You're just afraid of losing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you just running away
from facing it with all you've got?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not true.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's not wrong!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The you right now... isn't first-class at all!
You look totally uncool!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, look.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You sure have a lot to say,
but this doesn't even concern you in the first place, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...!
Of course it matters...!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I... I...!
Watching you is what made me into the King I am today!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—The Big Three. That's what everyone called us.
I was so very proud of that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yet by the time the Kikuka Sho had ended,
I was already... no longer there."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It was humiliating. It was agonizing.
I just didn't know what to do...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's when you said it.
"Master the unorthodox, and it becomes the royal road."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Before someone like me, who had never even dreamed
that such a path existed."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've made up my mind.
I'm going to run my own path—where I can shine the brightest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And then I found my path.
That is why, fully prepared, I challenged you—and yet—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you, of all people!
Why are you stopping in a place like this!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't you want to win anymore!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, whatever.
I was wrong about you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For all I care, you can just stay over there
and mope forever!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Saying you're disappointed in me, and all that...
Isn't that way too selfish...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you please leave me alone?
Please, I'm begging you."

Her voice was so faint and fading that
I couldn't say another word...
